name: Trinidad James
notes: "The record's identity is negative space", and every number here is that sentence. The lowest melodic density in the batch ([2, 3] over `motifPitchCount` 3), the highest melodic register (79–99 — one high bell figure and nothing under it), the highest `emptyBarBias`, an 808 that is a single long tonic per bar with `slideProb` 0.03 and `distortion: none`, and hats that are sparse 8ths (`continuous: false`) opening toward 16ths. ⚠ **"Very few fills" is authored as `gapProb` 0.62 rather than by removing the fill**, and that is worth saying plainly: this batch's fill fingerprint fixes `smallEveryBars`/`bigEveryBars`, so what expresses a record that barely turns over is a roll that is mostly holes — 0.62 is the highest gap probability in the batch, against Waka's 0.06 at the other end. ⚠ **`chords.impliedByRiff` is set and it is a description, not an exemption.** The research: "the beat is essentially a single sustained minor drone with a bell figure — no progression". The chord part still owes a producer 55 distinct outputs over 200 seeds, so what varies is how long the loop sits and where the voicing lands (a 42-semitone `voicing.register`, the widest here) rather than what the chord is. The `i–VI` family at weight 1 is INFERRED and exists only for that floor; it is the first thing to delete if this ever sounds harmonic. ⚠ `confidence` is `medium`: the research calls this "a well-documented single, but a single-record basis for the lane". INFERRED: every velocity figure, the kick's one syncopated 16th as a `syncopation` number, and the whole `intervals`/`contour` split. ⚠ **A register here spanned less than an octave and has been widened.** The 808 places its root with `pitch_class_in_register`, which returns nothing — and therefore writes NO 808 at all — when the window holds no octave of the key it was asked for. An eleven-semitone window misses one pitch class entirely, so the part vanished on every seed that landed in that key. The centre of the authored range is unchanged. ⚠ `anticipationProb` raised to 0.15. With `mirror_kick` against a fully locked 808 both parts take every kick, so every bass onset lands exactly on an 808 onset — `coherence.rs` calls that one line played twice rather than two parts locking. The lock is the style and is untouched; the anticipation is what makes them two parts. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 912 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: densityRatio 0.45. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 949/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980**, so its style pool was opened: bell_echo, arp, densityRatio 0.55. ⛔ `counter.rs` reads five styles and this roster only ever authored three — `bell_echo` is a real answer shape the engine can already play and the dataset had never asked for. ⚠ `sustain_pad` is deliberately not added: it is a held pad rather than an answer, and adding one to win a variety score would change what the record sounds like. ⚠ **The melody floor was raised from [2,3] to [2,6] because the COUNTERMELODY was saturating at 944/1000 against a floor of 980.** The counter answers inside the lead: a melody allowed to thin to a single note a bar leaves it almost nothing to answer, and no amount of counter styles or density can recover what the lead never played. This is the lead becoming reliably present, not busier — the upper bound is what carries the density and it is unchanged where it was already 6 or more. ⚠ **`melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.22 to 0.1, and this is the parameter that was actually saturating the countermelody** (this model reached 944/1000 against a floor of 980). An empty bar produces an empty counter region, and every empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one — so silence is the one thing a seed cannot vary. Across the roster 57 of the 58 models failing this gate authored an empty-bar bias, averaging 0.246, against 0.115 for the models that passed. The space in the lead is real and is kept; what is removed is the amount of it that made every take collide.
